svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A lathe part, from 32 mm steel bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tip: 12 mm spherical radius, 24 mm across where it meets the body.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Body 24 mm across, 20 mm long, for the 100 W nozzle heater band.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hex 27 mm across the flats, 8 mm long, for a spanner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spigot: M30 x 1.5 thread, 15 mm long, above the hex.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Orifice 4 mm, 20 mm deep from the tip; then 18 mm bore through the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rest, so melt meets no step bigger than 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: screws into the barrel's lower end with copper anti-seize until

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the hex face is tight on the barrel face; the bores line up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The tip seats in the mold's 12.5 mm spherical seat; it touches at the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: blow through it; the tip has no burr or flat.
